description:
Turkish team of four, named after Eugene Shoemaker

Melike Kızılay (team owner): Geological engineer interested in planetary science. Lunar targets and analog interpretation.

Zeynep Naz Erkoç: Geological engineer. Known analog catalogue and hard negatives.

Tarık Tuna Taşaltı: LLM researcher. Data pipeline, similarity model and validation.

Nagihan Koçcenk: Food engineer. Water and ISRU use cases.

Different fields, one shared curiosity about where on Earth we can practice for the Moon.
